errors.text_span: with major gridlines at intervals of 0.005
errors.evidence: The major gridlines on the y-axis, which are accompanied by numerical labels, are at intervals of 0.010 (e.g., 0.820, 0.830, 0.840). The interval between any two adjacent gridlines (major or minor) is 0.005, but the description incorrectly identifies these as the major gridline intervals.
The starting value for the blue "w.o. extension" line at step 0 is visibly above the 0.835 gridline, at approximately 0.836 or 0.837.

The description claims the blue line decreases more sharply. However, visually and by calculating the slopes, the orange line shows a larger overall decrease (approx. 0.022 from x=0 to x=4) compared to the blue line (approx. 0.017 from x=0 to x=4). The initial slope of the orange line is also steeper than the blue line. Therefore, this statement is factually incorrect.

The description uses the subjective term "worse" to describe the higher values of the "extension" condition. The chart itself does not provide any information to support this value judgment; it only shows the numerical difference.
The description omits the fact that the x-axis has no title or label, which is a characteristic of the plot's presentation.
